description: Interior of a 19th-century industrial hall. A large vertical steam engine with a brass-banded cylinder and a big flywheel dominates the centre-right, with a second engine behind it and steam rising. In the foreground, workmen with shovels dig a trench in a cobbled street, and a fire glows in the hole. Through an arched brick doorway on the left, a dusk street shows gas lamps and men holding torches. No visible text, frame or border.
